MeasuredClauseSetEquality:
∃ test : List Bool × List Bool → Bool,
      PEqualNP.Library.ComputableInPolyTime PEqualNP.Library.encodePair Computability.encodeBool test ∧
      ∀ c d : PEqualNP.Search.Clause, test (PEqualNP.Search.encodeClause c,PEqualNP.Search.encodeClause d) = true ↔ c.toFinset = d.toFinset
MeasuredResolutionStep:
let pair := fun (p q : List Bool) => List.replicate p.length true ++ false :: (p ++ q)
    ∃ test : List Bool → Bool,
      PEqualNP.Library.ComputableInPolyTime (fun x : List Bool => x) Computability.encodeBool test ∧
      ∀ a b c : PEqualNP.Search.Clause,
        test (pair (PEqualNP.Search.encodeClause a) (pair (PEqualNP.Search.encodeClause b) (PEqualNP.Search.encodeClause c))) = true ↔
          PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.IsResolvent a.toFinset b.toFinset c.toFinset
MeasuredResolutionLine:
let pair := fun (p q : List Bool) => List.replicate p.length true ++ false :: (p ++ q)
    ∃ test : List Bool → Bool,
      PEqualNP.Library.ComputableInPolyTime (fun x : List Bool => x) Computability.encodeBool test ∧
      ∀ (φ ρ : PEqualNP.Search.CNF) (c : PEqualNP.Search.Clause),
        test (pair (PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF φ) (pair (PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF ρ) (PEqualNP.Search.encodeClause c))) = true ↔
          (∃ a ∈ φ, a.toFinset = c.toFinset) ∨
          ∃ a ∈ ρ, ∃ b ∈ ρ, PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.IsResolvent a.toFinset b.toFinset c.toFinset
MeasuredClauseSuffixChecks:
∀ (valid : PEqualNP.Search.CNF → PEqualNP.Search.CNF → PEqualNP.Search.Clause → Prop)
    (query : List Bool → Bool)
    (hq : PEqualNP.Library.ComputableInPolyTime (fun x : List Bool => x) Computability.encodeBool query)
    (hv : let pair := fun (p q : List Bool) => List.replicate p.length true ++ false :: (p ++ q)
      ∀ (φ ρ : PEqualNP.Search.CNF) (c : PEqualNP.Search.Clause),
        query (pair (PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF φ) (pair (PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF ρ) (PEqualNP.Search.encodeClause c))) = true ↔ valid φ ρ c),
    ∃ test : List Bool × List Bool → Bool,
      PEqualNP.Library.ComputableInPolyTime PEqualNP.Library.encodePair Computability.encodeBool test ∧
      ∀ (φ ρ : PEqualNP.Search.CNF), test (PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF φ,PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF ρ) = true ↔
        ∀ (pre : PEqualNP.Search.CNF) (c : PEqualNP.Search.Clause) (older : PEqualNP.Search.CNF), ρ = pre ++ c :: older → valid φ older c
MeasuredResolutionDerivation:
∃ test : List Bool × List Bool → Bool,
      PEqualNP.Library.ComputableInPolyTime PEqualNP.Library.encodePair Computability.encodeBool test ∧
      ∀ (φ ρ : PEqualNP.Search.CNF), test (PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF φ,PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF ρ) = true ↔
        PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.IsDerivation
          {d : PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.Clause ℕ | ∃ c ∈ φ, c.toFinset = d} (ρ.map List.toFinset)
MeasuredCanonicalTraceWithEmptyClause:
∀ (valid : PEqualNP.Search.CNF → PEqualNP.Search.CNF → Prop)
    (learn : List Bool × List Bool → Bool)
    (hlearn : PEqualNP.Library.ComputableInPolyTime PEqualNP.Library.encodePair Computability.encodeBool learn)
    (hls : ∀ φ ρ : PEqualNP.Search.CNF, learn (PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF φ,PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF ρ) = true ↔ valid φ ρ),
    PEqualNP.Library.DecidableInPolyTime PEqualNP.Library.encodePair
      {p : List Bool × List Bool | ∃ (φ ρ : PEqualNP.Search.CNF), PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF φ = p.1 ∧ PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF ρ = p.2 ∧
        valid φ ρ ∧ [] ∈ ρ}
ExactResolutionRefutationVerifier:
PEqualNP.Library.DecidableInPolyTime PEqualNP.Library.encodePair
      {p : List Bool × List Bool | ∃ (φ ρ : PEqualNP.Search.CNF), PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF φ = p.1 ∧ PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF ρ = p.2 ∧
        PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.IsRefutation
          {d : PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.Clause ℕ | ∃ c ∈ φ, c.toFinset = d} (ρ.map List.toFinset)} ∧
    (∀ (φ ρ : PEqualNP.Search.CNF), PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.IsRefutation
      {d : PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.Clause ℕ | ∃ c ∈ φ, c.toFinset = d} (ρ.map List.toFinset) → ¬ PEqualNP.Search.Satisfiable φ)
ResolutionDerivationIsRUP:
∀ {V : Type} [DecidableEq V] (F : Set (PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.Clause V))
    (ρ : List (PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.Clause V)),
    PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.IsDerivation F ρ → PEqualNP.Search.IsRUPRun F ρ
BoundedResolutionRefutationsInNP:
∀ (q : Polynomial ℕ),
    {x : List Bool | ∃ (φ ρ : PEqualNP.Search.CNF), PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF φ = x ∧ (PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF ρ).length ≤ q.eval x.length ∧
      PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.IsRefutation {d : PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.Clause ℕ | ∃ c ∈ φ, c.toFinset = d} (ρ.map List.toFinset)} ∈ PEqualNP.Library.NP
